**nano.md 0.4.0 — see what your agent changed**

- **Change bars:** when the open file changes on disk, each heading,
  paragraph, list item and code block that differs from what was on
  screen gets a bar in the margin, in the preview and the editor.
- **Step through changes:** a bar above the document counts the changed
  and removed blocks. Its arrows jump between the changes, and its x
  clears them. Editing the document clears them too; saving doesn't.

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are still unsigned, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.4.0/CHANGELOG.md).
